To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
YY1 regulates the activity of a promoter by affecting DNA structure, and that the product of a gene involved in sex determination, SRY, is likely to function in a similar way.
YY1 is a structural transcription factor that regulates the activity of c-fos through an effect on promoter structure.

YY1 regulates the activity of a promoter primarily through an indirect effect on DNA structure, that the product of a sex determination gene may also function as a structural regulator, and that this class of transcription factors may be more prevalent than previously recognized.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the structure and function of transcriptional control regions in eukaryotic genes.
the role of DNA structure in gene regulation.
the role of DNA in transcriptional regulation and the mechanisms that control gene expression.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
YY1 is a DNA bending factor that can either repress or activate gene expression depending on the context in which it binds.
YY1 and SRY are DNA bending proteins that can function as transcriptional activators and repressors depending on the context of their binding sites and other proteins that interact with them.
the principal function for YY1 in this context is to regulate the structure of the promoter rather than to directly contact transcriptional machinery.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
DNA bending is a fundamental mechanism of transcriptional control.
YY1 is not an activator or repressor of c-fos, but rather a structural regulator of c-fos.
YY1 and SRY function as DNA bending proteins that influence transcription by affecting the path of the transcriptional machinery through the promoter.
The main takeaway from our work is that
DNA structure is important to the function of transcription factors, even in cases where there is no direct interaction with the transcriptional machinery.
DNA bending and orientation can have a significant influence on transcription factor activity.
DNA structure can be a critical determinant of transcriptional activity.
